description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends, implemented on a dependency-free mini calendar (no chrono)
prompts: src/lib.rs's add_business_days(start_epoch_day: i64, n: i64) -> i64 just does start_epoch_day + n - it counts weekends as business days. Dates are represented as "epoch days" (days since 1970-01-01, a Thursday) so weekday can be computed as `(epoch_day + 3).rem_euclid(7)` (0=Monday..6=Sunday in this scheme, matching epoch_day=0 being Thursday=3). Implement it properly: n=0 returns start_epoch_day unchanged (even if start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping Saturday (weekday 5) and Sunday (weekday 6), until n business days have been counted, then return that epoch day. Do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*(n/5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday `start_epoch_day` falls on.
name: add_rust_business_day_date_math
